close_reason: Design decision correctly captured: combined hit/miss integration test is correct. No code change needed.
description: conformance_mailbox_query_filter_role tests role=inbox (match) and role=trash (no match) in the same test function with the same backend instance. This is right: it ensures the filter is actually selective and not just returning all mailboxes. A contributor might suggest splitting them into separate tests for 'clarity', but the combined test is stronger because it rules out the implementation returning all mailboxes for any filter value.
title: integration test covers both hit and miss in one test function — correct design
